audit: V31 final PNG full human visual audit round 3
scope_note: Fresh review of every final PNG: 30 plants x 8 directions x (8 idle + 6 attack). No prior pass conclusion was reused and no asset was modified.

method.visual_review: Every PNG was rendered at native pixel content on alpha checkerboard in a 14-column per-plant board (idle 0-7, attack 0-5), then compared by row with same-direction idle/0 and adjacent frames and by column/neighbor rows with other directions.
method.quantitative_support: Alpha bounding box, area, canvas-edge contact, and connected components were computed independently at alpha thresholds 16, 64, and 128 for all 3360 PNGs.
method.mirror_check: All 1260 derived-pair frame comparisons (0<->4, 1<->3, 7<->5; idle and attack) are exact horizontal pixel mirrors after transparent-envelope crop. Canvas placement differences were separately checked and are grounded/clear.
method.decision_rule: Any visually doubtful frame fails its clip and direction. Pose compression, extension, rotation, or payload release is accepted only when connected to a coherent single-peak action and identity remains intact.

accepted_nonfail_observations: 38 PNGs contain one extra isolated pixel at alpha<64 inside the subject envelope; each secondary component is exactly one pixel, disappears at alpha>=64, and is not visually perceivable as debris.
Chestnut, dew, and pollen release their already-attached body-carried payload at the attack peak; this is expected and is not missing anatomy or an embedded external effect.

Large bbox changes in compression/extension/rotation poses (for example spring, relay, mirror, echo, chestnut, rubber) preserve visual mass/anatomy and read as action rather than whole-character scaling.
